title: Batch phone notifications to three deliveries per day.
subtitle: Notification boundary
rationale: Let notifications arrive on your schedule instead of the sender's, without going fully unreachable.

evidence.summary: A randomized trial found batching notifications to three daily deliveries improved attention and wellbeing versus default streams.

indications: The phone interrupts more than a few times per hour.
Notification settings have never been deliberately configured.
Full do-not-disturb feels too unreachable to sustain.
